<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8" />
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
<title>Canali Hồ Chí Minh — Ưu Đãi Đặc Biệt 02/09</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..144,400;0,9..144,500;0,9..144,600;1,9..144,500&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #F7F4EE;
    --surface: #FFFFFF;
    --ink: #1C1A17;
    --muted: #837A6D;
    --line: #E6E0D4;
    --accent: #6E1423;
    --accent-soft: #F1E4E1;
    --gold: #A9835A;
  }

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }

  body {
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--ink);
    font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  }

  /* ---------- Header ---------- */
  header {
    padding: 56px 24px 36px;
    text-align: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    position: relative;
  }

  .brand {
    margin-bottom: 30px;
  }

  .brand img {
    height: 34px;
    width: auto;
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .rule {
    width: 56px;
    height: 2px;
    background: var(--gold);
    margin: 30px auto 0;
  }

  /* ---------- Filter tabs ---------- */
  nav.tabs {
    position: sticky;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 10;
    background: rgba(247,244,238,0.92);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 18px 24px;
    display: flex;
    gap: 28px;
    overflow-x: auto;
    justify-content: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  nav.tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }

  .tab {
    background: none;
    border: none;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted);
    padding: 6px 2px 10px;
    cursor: pointer;
    white-space: nowrap;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease;
  }

  .tab:hover { color: var(--ink); }

  .tab.active {
    color: var(--ink);
    border-bottom-color: var(--accent);
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* ---------- Grid ---------- */
  main {
    max-width: 1240px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 48px 24px 100px;
  }

  .count {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--muted);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }

  .grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(250px, 1fr));
    gap: 36px 28px;
  }

  .card {
    background: var(--surface);
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .card-media {
    position: relative;
    aspect-ratio: 3 / 4;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #EFEBE2;
  }

  .card-media img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    display: block;
    transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);
  }

  .card:hover .card-media img {
    transform: scale(1.045);
  }

  /* garment-tag style discount badge */
  .tag {
    position: absolute;
    top: 14px;
    right: -6px;
    background: var(--accent);
    color: #F7F0EC;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    padding: 7px 14px 7px 12px;
    box-shadow: 0 3px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
  }
  .tag::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    right: -8px;
    top: 0;
    border-style: solid;
    border-width: 12px 8px 12px 0;
    border-color: transparent var(--accent) transparent transparent;
    transform: scaleX(-1);
    display: none;
  }

  .card-body {
    padding: 18px 2px 0;
  }

  .eyebrow {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--gold);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .pname {
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
    font-weight: 500;
    font-size: 18px;
    color: var(--ink);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    line-height: 1.3;
  }

  .pname .code {
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  .price-row {
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }

  .price-old {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: var(--muted);
    text-decoration: line-through;
    text-decoration-color: #BFB6A4;
  }

  .price-new {
    font-size: 19px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: var(--accent);
    font-family: 'Fraunces', serif;
  }

  .sizes {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    padding-bottom: 22px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  }

  .sizes-label {
    font-size: 10.5px;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted);
    margin-right: 2px;
  }

  .size-chip {
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: var(--ink);
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 3px 9px;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }

  /* ---------- Footer ---------- */
  footer {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
    padding: 40px 24px 56px;
    text-align: center;
  }

  footer p {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: var(--muted);
    max-width: 640px;
    margin: 0 auto 8px;
    line-height: 1.7;
    letter-spacing: 0.01em;
  }

  footer .fbrand {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  footer .fbrand img {
    height: 22px;
    width: auto;
    display: block;
    margin: 0 auto;
    opacity: 0.85;
  }

  .empty {
    display: none;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 80px 0;
    color: var(--muted);
    font-size: 14px;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    header { padding: 48px 20px 32px; }
    nav.tabs { gap: 18px; justify-content: flex-start; }
    .grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 28px 16px; }
    .pname { font-size: 16px; }
  }

  :focus-visible {
    outline: 2px solid var(--accent);
    outline-offset: 3px;
  }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    * { transition: none !important; }
  }
</style>
</head>

  <div class="fbrand"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Canali" /></div>
  <p>Điều kiện giảm giá: Mua 1 sản phẩm giảm 70% · Mua 3 sản phẩm giảm 75% · Mua 5 sản phẩm giảm 85%. Hóa đơn sau khi giảm giá trên 20 triệu đồng: giảm thêm 90% cho 1 sản phẩm bất kỳ.</p>
  <p>Ảnh minh họa cho sản phẩm thực tế đang có tại cửa hàng. Vui lòng liên hệ cửa hàng để kiểm tra tình trạng còn hàng theo size.</p>
</footer>

<script>
  const tabs = document.querySelectorAll('.tab');
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.card');
  const countEl = document.getElementById('count');
  const emptyEl = document.getElementById('empty');
  const gridEl = document.getElementById('grid');

  function applyFilter(cat) {
    let visible = 0;
    cards.forEach(card => {
      const match = cat === 'all' || card.dataset.cat === cat;
      card.style.display = match ? '' : 'none';
      if (match) visible++;
    });
    countEl.textContent = visible + ' sản phẩm';
    emptyEl.style.display = visible === 0 ? 'block' : 'none';
    gridEl.style.display = visible === 0 ? 'none' : 'grid';
  }

  tabs.forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      tabs.forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      tab.classList.add('active');
      applyFilter(tab.dataset.cat);
    });
  });

  applyFilter('all');
</script>

</body>
</html>
